title: docs(skills): four automation, query and ui evals spell their own must_contain literals
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XPR6X8mThHMiLNmP8gt1h7U)_

Fixes #33588

domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pDNPLKWseNj7nKqBo

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:四个技能 eval 的参考答案(`expected_output`)改为写出它们自己 `must_contain` 要求的字面拼写:automation 第 20 例写成 `type: 'subflow'`,automation 集成第 2 例把两个字段写成 `{ dialect: 'cel', source: … }` 信封,query 第 2 例用小写 `keyset`,ui 分析第 1 例写出 `dataset`。断言、提示、编号一字未动。
- 为什么改:这四例的参考答案用散文描述了这些写法,拿自己的评分器去判会失败,所以分不出对的回答和错的回答。四个字面拼写都是 `main` 上技能正文与 spec 教的写法,错的是参考答案。
- 风险与回滚:只动 eval 夹具(测量、不计入棘轮)与一个 changeset,不动 SKILL.md、规则文件、schema 或运行时;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json` 第 17 行(唯一一处多于一个词的改动),其余三处各一个词。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- skills/`,预期只见四行 `expected_output`,每行把散文换成带引号的字面拼写。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

Four `expected_output` strings, one per file. No `must_contain` / `must_not_contain` entry, prompt or id changes.

- **`objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` eval 20**: "A `subflow` node" becomes "A `type: 'subflow'` node".
- **`objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json` eval 2**: "`fields` read from the node's answer via CEL (`bal.body.available[0].amount / 100.0`, `isoDatetime(now())`)" becomes "... as CEL envelopes (`{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'bal.body.available[0].amount / 100.0' }`, `{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'isoDatetime(now())' }`)".
- **`objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json` eval 2**: "Keyset paging:" becomes "Use keyset paging:".
- **`objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json` eval 1**: "each widget binds it and selects" becomes "each widget names it in `dataset` and selects".
- **`.changeset/33588-skills-evals-own-literals.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` (the evals ship in the package's `dist/skills`), with both declaration lines.

## Why

Per literal, which side is wrong against `main` 6e287974 (order ruling: say which). In every case the literal is right and the `expected_output` is wrong: it named the construct in prose, so the reference answer failed its own grader.

| Eval | Literal | Taught on `main` at | Wrong side |
|---|---|---|---|
| automation flows 20 | `type: 'subflow'` | node table row `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:76`; node type enum `packages/spec/src/automation/flow.zod.ts:69`; written so in `examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts:775` | `expected_output` |
| automation integrations 2 | `dialect: 'cel'` | the same Stripe recipe, `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md:52-53`; the envelope rule, `SKILL.md:241` | `expected_output` |
| query 2 | `keyset` | `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md:247` ("For **keyset** paging (infinite scroll, ...)"), `rules/pagination.md:50-54` | `expected_output` (capitalised "Keyset" only) |
| ui analytics 1 | `dataset` | `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md:53` (`dataset: 'crm_sales'` on the widget); `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts:268` (`dataset` is required on a widget) | `expected_output` (said only `defineDataset`) |

The query literal is a case-only miss: a case-insensitive grader would have passed the old text. The grader is not in this repository, so the reference answer now matches the literal as written either way.

No `must_not_contain` literal of these four evals appears in the new text (checked by the script below; `integrations-declared` eval 2 forbids `token:`, `type: 'http'`, `registerConnector(` and `Authorization: 'Bearer`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Shape check over every `skills/*/evals/*.json`** (each eval: `must_contain` literals missing from `expected_output`, `must_not_contain` literals present in it), before on `origin/main` 6e287974, after on this head:

  | Bundle | evals | misses before | misses after | must_not_contain hits |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | objectstack-automation | 25 | 2 | 0 | 0 |
  | objectstack-query | 7 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
  | objectstack-ui | 29 | 1 | 0 | 1 (see below) |
  | objectstack-data | 37 | 3 | 3 | 0 |
  | objectstack-ai, -api, -formula, -i18n, -platform, -upgrade | 59 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
  | objectui | 34 | 17 | 17 | 0 |

- **objectstack-data's three are not touched here**: they are PR #33586 (card #33404), still open at this head; once it merges the data bundle reads 0.
- **objectui's 17** are that bundle's prose-summary convention (its own `ui` `check:skill-eval-tokens` checks tokens against the skill text, not against `expected_output`), out of the card's scope.
- **New, not in the card: `objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` eval 2 contains its own `must_not_contain` literal** `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'`, in the sentence "(never `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'`: that object read answers 404 ...)". A reference answer that warns against the wrong key in the key's own spelling fails its own grader the same way. That file is outside this card's surface and is the target of queued card #33560, so it is reported to the seat, not fixed here. The fix shape has precedent (a reference answer reworded so it names the forbidden form without its literal spelling; `packages/skills/CHANGELOG.md` line 1017).
- **Shape check as a gate (option, not added).** A check that every `must_contain` literal appears in its own `expected_output`, and no `must_not_contain` literal does, over `skills/objectstack-*/evals` would have stopped this drift and is about 15 lines over the existing JSON. Per the order it is the maintainer's call and is not added here.

## Verification

Head 68812739, base `origin/main` 6e287974.

<details><summary>Shape check before and after</summary>

One-off script (scratchpad, not committed) over every `skills/*/evals/*.json`.

- Before (`origin/main` 6e287974): automation flows-triggers-approvals 20 misses `type: 'subflow'`; automation integrations-declared 2 misses `dialect: 'cel'`; query filters-pagination-search 2 misses `keyset`; ui analytics-inline-vs-dataset 1 misses `dataset`; plus data 11, 12, 14 (PR #33586), ui views-apps-actions-pages 2 must_not_contain hit, objectui 17.
- After (68812739): the four are gone; nothing else moved. All four files still parse as JSON.

</details>

- `objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json`: 35 to 35 lines, 5519 to 5588 bytes, 1380 to 1397 tokens.
